one_line: Self-serve AI web scraping platform with API, CLI, SDKs and MCP server for extracting structured data.
auth_notes: API token created in the dashboard ('Token Plan' page); used as Bearer/auth header for REST API calls
self_serve_notes: Fully self-serve; sign up, create an API token in the dashboard, token-based billing ('Token Plan') with a playground and free quickstart to test

api_surface.breadth_estimate: REST API for AI/manual scrapers, bulk scraping, scheduling, scraper-as-endpoint (Scraper API), webhooks, proxies; full API reference published
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhook integration documented to send scraper results to external services

existing_mcp.note: Official MrScraper MCP Server documented in fetched text; also n8n node, Zapier integration, Python/Node.js/LangChain SDKs and CLI

evidence.note: fetched text confirms token auth, MCP server, CLI, SDKs, webhooks and API reference

agent_notes: Official MCP server exists, so an integration can wrap the REST API or proxy the MCP server directly.
